brief:
**BLUF:** In the core Tazewell area, Virginia voters rejected a proposed 1% school sales tax in Tazewell County on Nov. 3, while nearby localities in Southwest Virginia are advancing zoning changes to regulate data centers. Regionally, West Virginia State Police continue seeking public help locating a missing 26-year-old man last seen Nov. 8 near Athens in Mercer County, WV, and the Grundy Wrestling Club in Buchanan County, VA, has resumed practices after a Nov. 6 fire destroyed its gym.[[1]](https://woay.com/west-virginia-state-police-seeking-communitys-help-in-locating-missing-man-last-seen-on-november-8/)[[2]](https://cardinalnews.org/2026/11/16/as-tough-as-anybody-you-will-find-grundy-wrestling-club-is-back-on-the-mats-after-fire-totaled-gym/)[[3]](https://peoriastandard.com/tazewell-county-voters-turn-down-1-school-sales-tax)

## LAW ENFORCEMENT AND COURTS
**Core:** Nothing reported in the last 24 hours. Earlier this month, Virginia Conservation Police in Tazewell County, VA, seized more than 1,300 illegally gathered ginseng roots linked to trespassing and permit violations in the Bluefield area (reported Nov. 9).[[4]](https://www.wvva.com/2026/11/09/suspects-found-illegal-gathering-ginseng-cases/)

**Region:** West Virginia State Police are seeking the public’s help locating Tavon Dandre Davis, 26, last seen Nov. 8 in the Beckley area; he is described as a Black male, 6 feet tall, 218 pounds, last seen in a brown jacket, blue shirt, and gray sweatpants, possibly driving a gold 2004 Cadillac sedan. A cellphone ping placed him near Concord University in Athens, Mercer County, WV (updated Nov. 16). Contact WVSP at 304-746-2100.[[1]](https://woay.com/west-virginia-state-police-seeking-communitys-help-in-locating-missing-man-last-seen-on-november-8/)

## FIRE, EMS AND RESCUE
**Core:** Nothing reported in the last 24 hours.

**Region:** The Grundy Wrestling Club in Grundy, Buchanan County, VA, resumed practices and attended a tournament after a Nov. 6 morning fire (investigated as likely electrical, not suspicious) destroyed its gym on Grappler Road; the club is using temporary space such as the former Grundy High School gym while planning rebuild (reported Nov. 16).[[2]](https://cardinalnews.org/2026/11/16/as-tough-as-anybody-you-will-find-grundy-wrestling-club-is-back-on-the-mats-after-fire-totaled-gym/)

## HAZARDS, WEATHER AND ROADS
**Core/Region:** No active NWS alerts. No major road closures, power outages, or other hazards reported in the last 24 hours for the core or region.

## GOVERNMENT AND POLITICS
**Core:** Tazewell County, VA, voters rejected a proposed 1% school sales tax referendum on Nov. 3 (unofficial results: 45.2% yes, 54.8% no). Town elections included unopposed Mayor Joe R. Beasley in Tazewell and contested council seats.[[3]](https://peoriastandard.com/tazewell-county-voters-turn-down-1-school-sales-tax)[[5]](https://enr.elections.virginia.gov/results/public/tazewell-county/2026-November-General)

**Region:** Virginia’s three constitutional amendments on the Nov. 3 ballot drew mixed results across cities and counties. Some Southwest Virginia localities, including Wythe County and Washington County, are advancing zoning ordinances requiring special use permits for data centers to manage growth (reported Nov. 16).[[6]](https://cardinalnews.org/2026/11/16/some-southwest-virginia-localities-look-to-zoning-to-slow-down-data-centers/)

## ECONOMY AND OTHER
**Core:** Nothing reported in the last 24 hours.

**Region:** Some Southwest Virginia localities are using zoning to slow data center development amid concerns over impacts, while noting potential tax revenue (reported Nov. 16).[[6]](https://cardinalnews.org/2026/11/16/some-southwest-virginia-localities-look-to-zoning-to-slow-down-data-centers/)

## WATCH -- NEXT 48 HOURS
- Ongoing search for missing man Tavon Dandre Davis (Mercer County, WV).
- Grundy Wrestling Club activities continuing in temporary facilities (Buchanan County, VA).
- Data center zoning discussions in Southwest Virginia localities.
